ideas.pitch: A spatial farm defense network that predicts agricultural pest drift and disease outbreaks using OpenWeather data, Neo4j spatial indexing, and multilingual voice reporting.
ideas.title: AgriDefense Spatial Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agriculture domain with heavy inspiration from past regional winners that solved localized crop threats using spatial indexing.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered farming companion specifically tailored for Indian smallholder farmers to decide what to plant based on climate shifts, fix soil health, and access local markets.
ideas.title: Thulir Smallholder AI Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of combining practical agronomy with AI-for-good themes highly favored by engineering college judges in India.

ideas.pitch: A coastal intelligence platform monitoring marine temperature anomalies and predicting localized ocean-driven climate shifts affecting agrarian rainfall patterns.
ideas.title: ClimateOcean Marine Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific Climate & Ocean Intelligence domain, standing out from standard land-only agriculture projects.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition platform that maps local Indian dietary staples, regional food availability, and personal health metrics to deliver hyper-localized nutritional insights.
ideas.title: NutriGenie AI Regional Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven success of meal-and-nutrition hackathon winners by prioritizing actionable health advice for local demographics.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack transparent supply chain web application connecting local farmer co-ops directly with urban consumers for fresh produce logistics.
ideas.title: KisanBazar Direct-to-Consumer Fresh Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features clear, measurable economic impact for farmers by cutting out middlemen, matching the verified criteria of past supply-chain winners.
